flags.text: Isabella was the best team player!! She is always multitasking and is truly incredible at everything she does!! She is such a hard worker!
Tardy/early-out note: I let Bri go home about 10 mins early! We weren’t very busy at that time and she wasn’t feel well

Hazard reported: We had issues with the breaker switches all morning! The freeze machine and one of the rebel machines were both not releasing product, our pit fridge turned off and then both of our espresso machines turned off at one point. Luckily addy came in and got it all fixed for us super quickly!

My goal was for us to get drinks out asap!! We did have some newer bodies on shift that weren’t moving as quickly. Charlie struggled on bar today. He was making lots of drinks incorrectly, and seemed as if a lot of the basic knowledge wasn’t there/ he’s not where I would hope for him to be yet but he is still so new! He took a very long time to complete just one drink and therefore our window times were affected and it slowed us all down. He also was skipping over drinks at times as well. I’m hoping with the extra push and more practice he will truly improve soon!!

We had a lot of uncontrollable things go wrong on shift today! Lots of our equipment stopped working therefore we couldn’t use our espresso machine on walk bar which caused a bit of chaos but the crew managed even during the crazy points of the shift!! Luckily this only lasted for about an hour or so ,( if even) and then we were back better than ever!

- it was pretty slow from open until around 8:30 AM is when it finally picked up!

- a consistent morning once it picked up, but not very busy today!
